[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT): Short bursts of high-intensity exercise followed by brief periods of rest.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Gradually Increase Intensity and Duration: Help the body adapt to outdoor activities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Incorporate Hill Sprints: Sprint up a hill for 30-60 seconds, then walk or jog back down to recover.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Practice Breathing Exercises: Techniques like diaphragmatic breathing or box breathing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water or electrolyte-rich fluids.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Get Enough Rest and Recovery: Aim for 7-9 hours of sleep each night.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Mix Up Activities: Engage in various outdoor activities like hiking, biking, or kayaking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Listen to Your Body: Take breaks to avoid overexertion.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Nutrition and Fueling: Focus on a balanced diet with complex carbohydrates, lean protein, and healthy fats.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 12. Mental Preparation: Practice visualization techniques and focus on positive self-talk.
